headline: Going Commando adds shared effects, hero helpers and a corrected Damosel Orbit function
summary: Going Commando gains reconstructed game code for shared effects, hero helpers and updates on Oozla, Endako, Barlow and Snivelak (#300, #301, #302, #304, #307). The committed progress report puts USA v1.01 at 12.99% matched code, up from 12.78%, and 4,192 of 8,601 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. That progress update precedes several of the day's merges and separately records Europe/Australia at 3,576 of 8,693 functions and USA v2.00 at 3,994 of 8,655.
highlights: Damosel Orbit's wrapper gets a corrected starting address and a matching C implementation (#299).
Function checks now return failure when instructions, relocations or sizes differ, so batch tools can detect a failed check (#300).
The Dobbo Orbit hero-state dispatcher is reconstructed, but remains outside the matching build (#303).
Another 110 measured C reconstructions were retained without matching credit (#305). A further batch of 89 was proposed in #308 and had not merged.
The two large bodies documented in #288 still do not match. Its detailed records identify them as Joba and Barlow work despite the pull request's Yeedil label.
